T: Table for two. Make that three.
D: A pushover Rhode Island state trooper with a nasty second personality called Hank has to get a woman on the run from Massena back home.
P: Serve the sirloin when Boshane reports the shooting on the farm.
S: Brothy clam chowder with bacon, potato and thyme, no cream.

Dice the vegetables, then fry the bacon until crisp, add the onion and celery and soften. Add the potatoes, clam juice, stock and thyme and simmer until the potatoes are tender. Stir in the clams and warm through, then season with lots of pepper. Finish with parsley and serve with crackers.
2 x 290g tins baby clams, juice kept@Seafood
I got no beef with you, says Hank.

Soften the onion and garlic in a little oil, add the spices, beans and tomatoes and simmer until thick. Layer the corn chips, chilli and cheese on a tray and bake at 200C until the cheese melts. Top with jalapenos, sour cream and smashed avocado.
M: Grilled sirloin with fries. Six bullets, and the cow's lucky to be alive.

Bake the chips at 220C until crisp. Rub the steaks with oil and salt and grill over high heat, 3 to 4 minutes a side, then rest. Soften the shallot in the butter, add the pepper, stock, cream and mustard and bubble until thick. Serve the steaks with pepper sauce and chips.
Hank yells: free hot dogs, all you can eat.

Brown the mince with the diced onion, breaking it up very finely. Add the paprika, cumin, allspice, water and salt and simmer until saucy. Simmer the franks in hot water and warm the rolls. Fill the rolls with franks, mustard, meat sauce, chopped raw onion and a shake of celery salt.
1 brown onion, finely diced, plus 1 more for topping@Produce
W: Apple pie in a cheddar crust. Lieutenant at last.

Rub the butter into the flour, stir in the cheddar and enough iced water to bring it together, then chill. Toss the apples with the sugar, cornflour and cinnamon. Roll out two thirds of the pastry to line a 23cm pie dish, fill with apples and top with the rest. Brush with egg, cut steam holes and bake at 200C until golden and bubbling. Cool a little and serve with ice cream.
6 Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced@Produce
K: Sweet coffee syrup stirred into cold milk, a study-night glass.
Simmer the coffee and sugar until slightly thickened, then cool. Stir 3 tablespoons of syrup into each glass of cold milk. Add ice and serve.
